overview_description.description:
FSC is a market leader in retail based financial services. Our professional team and widespread service teams enable our clients to attain the utmost satisfaction.
 
FSC was founded in 2008 with the idea of providing a suite of field based services to banks and financial sectors. Quickly, FSC proved its success and creative approach and diversity.
 
FSC today operates Vodafone One loyalty system as well as having launched Egypt’s first anonymous prepaid cards nationwide, in collaboration with SAIB bank.
 
FSC is currently operating in Egypt with a strategic plan to expand in the MENA region, specifically into North Africa and GCC markets. Our regional expansion is driven by our success and our belief that FSC has the capability and resources to serve its customers wherever and whenever required.

press_references.value: 11th Circ. Won't Revive ADA Suit Over Remote Work Firing

legal_proceedings.description: A financial services company was involved in an ADA lawsuit regarding the firing of an employee who requested remote work due to Crohn's disease. The 11th Circuit Court upheld the company's decision, stating that the company had legitimate reasons for the firing and had reasonably accommodated the employee's request during the COVID-19 pandemic.
